title: Steven Universe
description: A young boy takes his mother’s place in a group of gemstone-based beings, and must learn to control his powers.

episodes.title: S4-E6Last One Out of Beach City

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x1
episodes_data.description: Steven gets depressed when his favorite ice-cream sandwich brand, Cookie Cat, has been taken off the market. He soon cheers up when the Gems manage to get a hold of some of the last remaining Cookie Cats, which Steven believes may hold the key to activating his gem.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x2
episodes_data.description: When a menacing red eye is about to hit Beach City, the only thing that can destroy it is a Laser Light Cannon which once belonged to Steven's mother, Rose Quartz. Thus, Steven enlists the help of his father, Greg, and they search through his storage for the cannon.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x3
episodes_data.description: The Gems go on a mission to place a Moon Goddess statue on top of the ruined Lunar Sea Spire, and Steven tries to prove he can be useful with the help of his new novelty cheeseburger backpack.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x4
episodes_data.description: Steven's attempt to get the Gems to share his special breakfast tradition lands him on a journey through their ancient Gem temple.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x5
episodes_data.description: Steven brings a mascot costume to life with a magic shard owned by Pearl to help his friend Peedee with his job, but it backfires when the mascot goes rogue.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x6
episodes_data.description: Steven tries to master his shapeshifting abilities from Amethyst, but turns his fingers into cats, making it harder to do things.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x7
episodes_data.description: Steven creates a magic bubble around himself and a girl he likes, Connie, to save her from a falling rock, but has no idea how to make it disappear.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x8
episodes_data.description: While navigating out of an ancient Gem maze, Steven tries to prove himself worthy to Garnet by being serious.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x9
episodes_data.description: Steven joins an underground wrestling league with Amethyst, who is tired of Pearl and Garnet bringing her down.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x10
episodes_data.description: Steven befriends a magical lion he finds in the desert during a mission with the Gems.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x11
episodes_data.description: Steven takes the Gems on his own kind of adventure by bringing them to the Fun Land Arcade, where Garnet soon becomes enchanted by a dancing game.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x12
episodes_data.description: Steven urges Amethyst and Pearl to fuse together into a four-armed "giant woman" named Opal (Aimee Mann). Amethyst and Pearl, however, keep on quarrelling.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x13
episodes_data.description: After learning that the Gems are thousands of years old, Steven decides to make up for all the birthdays they've missed.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x14
episodes_data.description: Steven and Lars get to hang out with the cool kids (Jenny Pizza, Buck Dewey and Sour Cream) in town, but their teenage shenanigans get them into magical trouble.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x15
episodes_data.description: A toy trade between Steven and Onion escalates into epic proportions.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x16
episodes_data.description: Pearl gets injured and retreats into her gem to heal and make a new body to project after she tries to teach Steven the art of sword-fighting using a holographic version of herself.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x17
episodes_data.description: Steven and Connie try to ride Lion to the movie theater, but Lion has other plans.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x18
episodes_data.description: After a battle damages the Fish Stew Pizza sign, the Gems are banned from the restaurant, so Steven throws a cookout on the beachside to mend the relationship between the Pizza family and the Gems.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x19
episodes_data.description: Steven's desire for some alone time unlocks a new room in the Temple that answers his every wish.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x20
episodes_data.description: Against Pearl's wishes, Steven becomes determined to get stronger after watching Garnet and Amethyst fuse into the mighty Sugilite.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x21
episodes_data.description: Steven works at the Big Donut when Lars leaves Sadie with all the work.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x22
episodes_data.description: Steven needs a musical partner for an upcoming show, so he uses a time travel device to recruit himself as the perfect bandmate.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x23
episodes_data.description: Steven attempts to tame a monster's wild form when he accidentally releases it from its gem bubble.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x24
episodes_data.description: Steven tells Connie about his mission with the Gems to heal Amethyst after she cracks her gemstone.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x25
episodes_data.description: Steven befriends a magical mirror that can mysteriously communicate with only him and ends up setting free its trapped inhabitant, a Gem named Lapis Lazuli.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x26
episodes_data.description: Lapis Lazuli disappears after reigniting a past conflict with Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl, and takes the ocean along with her, leaving Beach City in a panic on the first day of summer. Steven, Connie, Greg, Lion and the Gems go on a mission to confront Lapis and set things back to normal.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x27
episodes_data.description: Left homeless and with a broken leg after the events of the previous episode, Greg stays with Steven and the Gems as a temporary house guest and unintentionally interferes with Steven's healing powers.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x28
episodes_data.description: Steven, Pearl and Greg work together to build a spaceship so that Pearl can revisit the wonders of the cosmos, but Pearl gets a little carried away.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x29
episodes_data.description: After they accidentally pop a bubble containing gem shards, Steven, Amethyst and Pearl form a secret team to retrieve the shards before Garnet finds out.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x30
episodes_data.description: Steven tries to mend Lars' and Sadie's friendship by taking them on vacation to a magical beach.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x31
episodes_data.description: Steven is taken in by Ronaldo's conspiracy theories about paranormal occurrences in Beach City.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x32
episodes_data.description: Steven asks the Gems to fuse together and pretend to be his mother at dinner with Connie's family.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x33
episodes_data.description: Steven interprets what Garnet did during the day after a recent mission.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x34
episodes_data.description: Steven grows a patch of watermelons shaped like himself, but they soon come to life and attack people.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x35
episodes_data.description: Lion keeps lying on Steven's face while he's sleeping. This leads to Steven discovering a pocket dimension in Lion's mane.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x36
episodes_data.description: Steven becomes uneasy after seeing an unknown object traversing through a warp stream, despite the Gems' attempts to disprove his claims.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x37
episodes_data.description: While practicing how to fuse with Gems, Steven accidentally fuses with Connie, forming a half-human and half-Gem, human fusion called Stevonnie.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x38
episodes_data.description: Steven finds out that the Lunar Sea Spire mission from the third episode was a test and demands a new one.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x39
episodes_data.description: Steven learns that Garnet can see into the future and becomes paranoid about the possible dangers around him.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x40
episodes_data.description: Steven and Amethyst try life out on the road. During so, Amethyst reveals a dark secret about herself and the Gems to Steven.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x41
episodes_data.description: Steven goes to the lighthouse to watch scary movies with Ronaldo, Lars and Sadie.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x42
episodes_data.description: Steven has to take Connie back to her home before a blizzard hits Beach City, and Garnet shows him some outcomes before they leave.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x43
episodes_data.description: While cleaning out Greg's storage unit, Greg and Amethyst are reunited with their favorite sitcom Li'l Butler.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x44
episodes_data.description: When several droids from space descend towards warp pad zones, Steven and the Gems attempt to track down their purposes.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x45
episodes_data.description: Pearl takes Steven to a special place that belonged to Rose Quartz after Lion finds the scabbard for Rose's sword.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x46
episodes_data.description: Steven and the Gems need Greg's help to retrieve a message from the Wailing Stone.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x47
episodes_data.description: The Gems cause a power outage in Beach City, and Steven helps Mayor Dewey with damage control.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x48
episodes_data.description: Peridot and her new partner, Jasper, arrive on Earth.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x49
episodes_data.description: Trapped on Peridot's ship, Steven attempts to rescue the Gems from the Homeworld's clutches, including two Gems named Ruby and Sapphire.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x50
episodes_data.description: Steven tries to avoid Connie so he won't have to tell her about his ordeal with the Homeworld Gems from the previous episodes.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x51
episodes_data.description: When Connie is upset by the ending of her favorite book series, Steven takes her to Rose Quartz's room, where they remake the ending.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 1x52
episodes_data.description: Buck, Jenny and Sour Cream take Steven out on a late-night joyride to lift his spirits and teach him how to have fun, until they end up discovering Peridot's escape pod.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x1
episodes_data.description: Steven and Peridot attempt to catch an elusive speedy corrupted Gem monster in the Beta Kindergarten.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x2
episodes_data.description: Steven and the Gems examine fusions.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x3
episodes_data.description: Steven visits the library with Connie and uncovers a long lost book.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x4
episodes_data.description: Steven and Connie learn to focus better.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x5
episodes_data.description: Steven tells people's fortunes at Funland.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x6
episodes_data.description: Pearl, Steven and Amethyst go to a rock show.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x7
episodes_data.description: Steven learns about Onion's secret group of friends.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x8
episodes_data.description: In this double episode Steven’s autumn visit to the barn brings a new stranger into his life.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x9
episodes_data.description: Greg tells Steven about their first winter together

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x10
episodes_data.description: A strange dream prompts Steven to search for answers.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x11
episodes_data.description: Steven and the Gems take off on a search and recovery mission.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x12
episodes_data.description: The Gems reach a space station that once belonged to Pink Diamond, and sneak in to rescue Greg, but in order to do so, they must play the roles they were made for, so as not to arouse suspicion.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x13
episodes_data.description: Steven finds Greg in Pink Diamond's "Human Zoo", and tries to look for a way out. This proves easier said than done as the humans there are guided through a strictly scheduled and regimented life

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x14
episodes_data.description: While Blue Diamond and Yellow Diamond argue over their diverging ways of coping with Pink Diamond's death, Steven, Greg and the Crystal Gems attempt to escape the space station before they are discovered.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x15
episodes_data.description: Connie tells Steven the story of how she, Peridot, and Lapis attempted to take the Crystal Gems' places as the protectors of Beach City while he was in space.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x16
episodes_data.description: Steven uses his room in the temple to create a simulated image of Rose Quartz in order to try to experience what it would be like to know his mother. He ends up confronting her with his troubled feelings about her complex legacy and her choice to create him.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x17
episodes_data.description: Ronaldo decides to join the Crystal Gems. However, once Steven lets him join the team, Ronaldo's self-centered attitude begins to try Steven's patience.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x18
episodes_data.description: When Amethyst quits wrestling at the abandoned warehouse, Steven continues doing so himself as Tiger Philanthropist. However, Steven soon begins to doubt the point of wrestling when the audience doesn't take to his new persona.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x19
episodes_data.description: "Navy", one of the Rubies who came to Earth to find Jasper, crashes on Earth and is welcomed in by Steven to be a Crystal Gem. However, Lapis Lazuli does not trust Navy's overly optimistic nature, knowing of her previous encounters with her.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x20
episodes_data.description: Steven tries to search for secret messages Rose may have left him about his "magical destiny". Lion eventually leads him to a tape—but it's just an alternate version of the message from Rose he's already seen.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x21
episodes_data.description: Steven and Connie join Connie's father on a stake out.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x22
episodes_data.description: Steven, Lars and Sadie get invited to a party with the Cool Kids.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x23
episodes_data.description: People disappearing from Beach City, and Steven tries to solve the mystery.

episodes_data.title: Steven Universe 4x24
episodes_data.description: Steven struggles to fix his mistakes.
